tour: Generated background page includes HEAD-tree README/contribution/PR-template excerpts, observed merge/Conventional/signature-header/Signed-off-by history and branch/tag names.
Reuses Activity immutable canonicalized unique-commit history for90-day top-folder contributors/hot files; shows shallow/partial coverage and document/history caps.

Detects LFS, gitlinks/submodules, Husky/Lefthook/pre-commit and EditorConfig; setup actions set repository identity, install local LFS hooks, confirm submodule initialization, and guide local hook/editor/signing setup.
Generation/lifetime checks reject closed/replaced answers. Real repository, actual checklist/close UI and recording-only encoded-SSH routing tests pass.
portability: Versioned8MiB allowlisted file captures public profiles/display settings/saved authors and selected recent/open repository remotes/local author/hidden refs/worktree descriptors.

Credentials/tokens/private or signing keys/authentication folders/generated configs/leases/executable settings/rawGitconfig are excluded; standard credential-bearing remote components are stripped and command/file/HTTP helpers rejected.

Import preview makes no changes. Explicit public restore adds fresh profile IDs and authors, preserves the active profile, and retains public account/key/signing expectations as pending. Startup, activation, Git/CLI/forge guards fail closed until fresh required setup.

Fresh GitHub/GitLab named-owner checks use reviewed connection APIs; Tea requires its exact alias, public host and actual owner metadata; SSH/signing require current-machine selections. No imported auth paths become active.

Explicit local destination/newname and selected clone actions restore exact named branch/detached commit, remotes, local author, hidden branches and linked worktree descriptors/locks, with no hook/template/filter command execution or lazy fetching during restoration.

Existing paths and missing branches are refused; partial outcomes and private in-memory unchanged-clone/config receipts support retries without rollback/deletion. Deleted profile associations cannot be reassigned to ambient profiles. Successful clones join their corresponding recent lists and open only explicitly.

Real UI/file/import/freshsetup/activation/clone round-trip, actual local repository/worktree/retry/missingbranch/nooverwrite, malformeddata, secret exclusion, Tea owner change, stale/cancel and hostile inherited Practice/local-source Git environment tests pass.

limits: Tour observations are not policy or signature/DCO verification; linear history cannot establish squash versus rebase.

Tour uses at most5000 unique commits when no cached Activity history is available,20 documents256KiB each/6000 displayed characters,2000 ref names,100 folders/top5 authors and25 hot files. Missing objects are not fetched.

Portable setup restores an allowlist of public display/settings fields and built-in themes. Custom themes, shell/editor/signing programs, worktree-specific author overrides and machine-specific auth/config require local setup.
Version1 bounds:64 profiles/repositories/worktrees,256 saved identities,32 remotes,16 push URLs per remote and2000 hidden refs; conservative ASCII ref/folder names and UTF-8 metadata.

Network clone defaults to the first portable remote listed in the file; a current-machine local source can be explicitly picked. Named branches use the selected source current tip, with notice on exported-tip mismatch; local-only objects/working files/stashes need separate backup.

Private retry receipts last only the current app session and unchanged owned clone/config; failed initial clones and partial results remain for manual inspection or a fresh destination. LFS objects/submodule content need separate setup.
No live providers/credentials/SSH/WSL hosts or Windows runtime were used. Remote routing uses a recording-only local launcher; profile setup fixtures use synthetic local data.
